resources.string:
Turn your phone into a Contax T3.

The viewfinder shows the real optical world; each press of the shutter advances a 36-frame roll; when the roll is done you send it to the darkroom, and the film engine develops every frame with that roll's recipe.

Until it is developed, nobody knows what you got — that is the fun of film.

resources.string:
Shoot it like a real film camera:

· Tap to focus, swipe up or down for exposure
· 36 frames to a roll, then off to the darkroom
· Nothing to see until it is developed — that's the fun of film
All 36 frames are shot. Develop the roll for prints.
A roll holds 36 frames; only the first 36 were taken
Develop the current roll before importing
Auto pairs each stock with its maker\'s recommended paper (Kodak negatives on Portra Endura, cine film on Kodak 2383). Tap above to pick one yourself.
Debug: skip development, print at once
Development and debugging only — no need to touch these.
Thanks for backing an indie dev — scan the QR code, or use PayPal below

Engineering Mode is an expert panel for enthusiasts: hand-tune input exposure, enlarger exposure, and the emulsion and print-layer parameters so every roll comes out the way you want.

A one-time purchase, not a subscription — buy once and keep it forever. Reinstalling or switching phones restores it at no extra charge.

Relic Cam itself has no network permission; the purchase is handled by Google Play, so your photos still cannot leave this phone.

Shoot at film shutter speed in low light — the shake is the point
Sonnar softness on film (part of the body, not per roll)
0 = off (digital-sharp) · 4 invisible · 8 slight · 12 default · 20 soft · 35 dreamy. Takes effect on the next development.
Undo the extra colour added by the phone ISP (JPG / import only)

Default 60% (calibrated on real shots: removes 15-29% of excess saturation with almost no brightness shift) · 0 = off (pixel-identical to the previous version) · 100% looks pale and slightly bright. One roll, one baseline: the first frame sets the strength and all 36 frames share it, so a roll never shifts in colour. Flat, night and near-monochrome scenes are damped or skipped. Device-agnostic: it measures how much the input was already graded by the ISP, so every phone gets its own strength. JPG and imported photos only; RAW is untouched and no film/printing parameter is changed. Takes effect on the next development.

Capture RAW (16-bit Bayer, bypassing the ISP tone mapping / AWB / multi-frame stacking) alongside JPEG. The DNG is kept as the negative (~25–40MB each) and developed through the engine RAW session. Falls back to the JPEG path on any failure.
Fix skin tone (yellowish) with enlarger filters

Yellowish skin: drag warmth toward cool/fair; add a touch of magenta if still yellow. The two filters alone are very weak (full scale moves only a level or two) — raise filter strength to see real change. Defaults +1.00/+0.10, strength 15; strength 0 = off. Print output only (lab-scan styles keep their own signature); takes effect on the next development.
Enlarged onto paper, or the lab scanning the negative
Grain · halation · glare · exposure offset · paper (saved per film stock)
Pure chance: sometimes blurred, sometimes sharp
Pure faithful: always slow in low light
Faithful + slight luck: always slow, sometimes one stop slower
All three need Slow shutter on this page set to Natural or Slow. Never fires in daylight or with flash.
Slide film cannot be printed — this version only supports negatives
